objective: A dependency lock whose packages carry no artifact hashes is refused, so provenance cannot report itself complete while pinning versions to nothing.
decision_supported: Is name==version a lock? No: without hashes nothing ties the version to bytes, and the manifest reported hashed_package_count 0 as complete.
acceptance: A lock whose packages omit hashes is refused by verify_manifest.
A lock whose packages carry sha256 hashes still verifies.
stop_conditions: The change would need a lock format change.
risks_and_fallbacks: A constraints file without hashes can no longer build a promotable manifest; the fix is to generate a hashed lock, which lock-python already does.
